name: agent-custody
description: Proof of what your AI agents did. Give your agents real power, without losing control of them.

scripts.test:python: bun run build && cd packages/python && uv run --extra test pytest -q
scripts.coverage: bun run --cwd packages/receipts coverage && bun run --cwd packages/state coverage && bun run coverage:python && node .github/scripts/coverage-summary.mts
scripts.coverage:python: bun run build && cd packages/python && uv run --extra test pytest -q --cov=agent_custody --cov-report=term --cov-report=json:coverage/coverage.json
scripts.ci: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run site:build && bun run test:python
